record.paper_title: Packings and coverings of groups: some results and open problems
record.context_brief: Covering spectrum of an infinite group
record.original_question: Let G be an infinite group. For a subset A of G, let cov(A) be the least cardinality of a set S of group elements such that G = SA, and let Cov(G) be the set of all values cov(A) as A ranges over subsets of G. Is Cov(G) exactly the whole cardinal interval [1, |G|], meaning that every cardinal kappa with 1 <= kappa <= |G| occurs as cov(A) for some subset A of G?

evidence.quote: cov(A) = min{|S|: S ⊆ G, G = SA}.
Problem 3. Is it true that Cov(G) = [1, |G|] for every infinite group G?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be an infinite group. For a subset $A \subseteq G$, define the covering number
$$\operatorname{cov}(A) = \min\{|S| : S \subseteq G \text{ and } G = SA\},$$
where $SA = \{sa : s \in S, a \in A\}$. Define the covering spectrum
$$\operatorname{Cov}(G) = \{\operatorname{cov}(A) : A \subseteq G\}.$$
Let $[1, |G|]$ denote the set of all cardinals $\kappa$ with $1 \le \kappa \le |G|$.

Determine whether for every infinite group $G$ one has $\operatorname{Cov}(G) = [1, |G|]$; that is, whether every cardinal $\kappa$ with $1 \le \kappa \le |G|$ is realized as $\operatorname{cov}(A)$ for some subset $A \subseteq G$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turn up related work by Protasov, Banakh, Slobodianiuk and others on covering numbers and partitions of groups, but no source was found that explicitly resolves whether Cov(G) equals the full cardinal interval [1,|G|] for every infinite group. The status of this specific question appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: The covering number of the difference sets in partitions of G-spaces and groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cov(A) for subsets of groups in the context of partitions; addresses related conjectures of Protasov but does not settle the [1,|G|] spectrum question.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on covering numbers exists but does not resolve the spectrum problem.

status_evidence.title: A conjecture on partitions of groups
status_evidence.snippet: Treats Protasov-type conjectures about cov on cells of partitions; does not resolve Cov(G)=[1,|G|].
status_evidence.claim: Adjacent conjectures are partially confirmed (e.g. for regular cardinalities, abelian groups), but the spectrum question itself is not stated as resolved.
